label: Track every actual recipient to the same root using uniqueness and finite access (inference)
rule: Induct on each finite access derivation and identify its initial root on the same profile
meaning: On ConcreteExistentialSupply.graph m w, all nodes are the actual concreta of this world and all edges are its selected grounding edges. Each recipient's access derivation starts at a root. Uniqueness identifies every such initial node with the supplied root. This constructs a finite path for each recipient on the actual subtype. No common path length, direct coverage or universal termination is assumed.
